title: Patroni: restore round-trip
description: Runs `nexus backup restore postgres <id>`: restores the dump into a throwaway database the operator owns (CREATEDB) and counts rows.

observe.what: items restored = 3 (the nexus_smoke rows) into db nexus_restore_verify

whatProves: PatroniAdapter.BackupRestoreAsync proves a non-destructive round-trip into an operator-owned database (not a schema-in-postgres, which the data-only operator grants cannot create -- ADR-0013 bug #3).
